mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sa_file_asset (user_id, type, original_name, storage_key, url, mime_type, file_size) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{originalName}, #{storageKey}, #{url}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, type, original_name, storage_key, url, mime_type, file_size, create_time FROM sa_file_asset WHERE storage_key = #{storageKey} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
